+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import csv
+import io
+import json
+import math
+import os
+import re
+import statistics
+import sys
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any
+
+
+class NuError(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+@dataclass
+class TextOut:
+    text: str
+    newline: bool = True
+
+
+class Lexer:
+    def __init__(self, src: str):
+        self.src = src
+        self.i = 0
+        self.tokens: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
+
+    def lex(self):
+        s = self.src
+        while self.i < len(s):
+            c = s[self.i]
+            if c.isspace() or c == ',':
+                self.i += 1
+                continue
+            if c in '()[]{};:|':
+                if c == '|' and self._peek(1) == '|':
+                    self.tokens.append(('sym', '||')); self.i += 2; continue
+                self.tokens.append(('sym', c)); self.i += 1; continue
+            two = s[self.i:self.i+2]
+            three = s[self.i:self.i+3]
+            if three == '..<':
+                self.tokens.append(('op', three)); self.i += 3; continue
+            if two in ('==', '!=', '<=', '>=', '//', '**', '..', '=~', '!~'):
+                self.tokens.append(('op', two)); self.i += 2; continue
+            if c in '+-*/<>=':
+                self.tokens.append(('op', c)); self.i += 1; continue
+            if c in ('"', "'"):
+                self.tokens.append(('str', self._string(c))); continue
+            if c == '$':
+                j = self.i + 1
+                while j < len(s) and (s[j].isalnum() or s[j] in '_-'):
+                    j += 1
+                self.tokens.append(('var', s[self.i+1:j])); self.i = j; continue
+            if c.isdigit() or (c == '-' and self._peek(1).isdigit()):
+                self.tokens.append(('num', self._number())); continue
+            if c == '#':
+                while self.i < len(s) and s[self.i] != '\n':
+                    self.i += 1
+                continue
+            j = self.i
+            while j < len(s) and not s[j].isspace() and s[j] not in '()[]{};:|,+*/<>=':
+                if s[j] in ('"', "'"):
+                    break
+                j += 1
+            self.tokens.append(('word', s[self.i:j])); self.i = j
+        self.tokens.append(('eof', ''))
+        return self.tokens
+
+    def _peek(self, n):
+        p = self.i + n
+        return self.src[p] if p < len(self.src) else ''
+
+    def _string(self, q):
+        self.i += 1
+        out = []
+        while self.i < len(self.src):
+            c = self.src[self.i]
+            if c == q:
+                self.i += 1
+                return ''.join(out)
+            if q == '"' and c == '\\' and self.i + 1 < len(self.src):
+                self.i += 1
+                m = {'n': '\n', 'r': '\r', 't': '\t', '"': '"', '\\': '\\'}
+                out.append(m.get(self.src[self.i], self.src[self.i]))
+            else:
+                out.append(c)
+            self.i += 1
+        raise NuError('expected closing ' + q)
+
+    def _number(self):
+        j = self.i
+        if self.src[j] == '-':
+            j += 1
+        while j < len(self.src) and (self.src[j].isdigit() or self.src[j] in '._'):
+            if self.src[j:j+2] == '..':
+                break
+            j += 1
+        return self.src[self.i:j].replace('_', '')
+
+
+class Parser:
+    PRECEDENCE = {
+        'or': 1, 'xor': 1, 'and': 2,
+        '==': 3, '!=': 3, '<': 3, '<=': 3, '>': 3, '>=': 3, '=~': 3, '!~': 3, 'in': 3, 'not-in': 3, 'has': 3, 'not-has': 3,
+        'bit-or': 4, 'bit-xor': 5, 'bit-and': 6,
+        'bit-shl': 7, 'bit-shr': 7,
+        '+': 8, '-': 8, '*': 9, '/': 9, '//': 9, 'mod': 9, '**': 10,
+        '..': 11, '..<': 11,
+    }
+
+    def __init__(self, src: str, env=None):
+        self.tokens = Lexer(src).lex()
+        self.i = 0
+        self.env = env or {}
+
+    def parse(self):
+        parts = self._split_top('|')
+        value = None
+        for idx, part in enumerate(parts):
+            if idx == 0:
+                value = Parser.from_tokens(part, self.env).expr()
+            else:
+                value = run_command(value, part, self.env)
+        return value
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_tokens(cls, toks, env):
+        obj = cls('', env); obj.tokens = toks + [('eof', '')]; obj.i = 0; return obj
+
+    def _split_top(self, sym):
+        parts, cur, depth = [], [], 0
+        for t in self.tokens[:-1]:
+            if t[1] in '([{': depth += 1
+            elif t[1] in ')]}': depth -= 1
+            if t == ('sym', sym) and depth == 0:
+                parts.append(cur); cur = []
+            else:
+                cur.append(t)
+        parts.append(cur)
+        return parts
+
+    def expr(self, minp=0):
+        left = self.unary()
+        while True:
+            typ, val = self.peek()
+            op = val if typ in ('op', 'word') and val in self.PRECEDENCE else None
+            if not op or self.PRECEDENCE[op] < minp:
+                break
+            self.i += 1
+            rp = self.PRECEDENCE[op] + (0 if op == '**' else 1)
+            right = self.expr(rp)
+            left = apply_op(op, left, right)
+        return self.cell_path(left)
+
+    def unary(self):
+        typ, val = self.peek()
+        if val == 'not':
+            self.i += 1; return not truthy(self.unary())
+        if val == '-' and self.tokens[self.i+1][0] == 'num':
+            self.i += 1; return -self.unary()
+        return self.primary()
+
+    def primary(self):
+        typ, val = self.peek(); self.i += 1
+        if typ == 'num':
+            return float(val) if '.' in val else int(val)
+        if typ == 'str':
+            return val
+        if typ == 'var':
+            return self.env.get(val)
+        if typ == 'word':
+            if val == 'true': return True
+            if val == 'false': return False
+            if val == 'null': return None
+            return val
+        if val == '(':
+            out = self.expr(); self.expect(')'); return out
+        if val == '[':
+            return self.list_or_table()
+        if val == '{':
+            return self.record()
+        raise NuError('parse error')
+
+    def list_or_table(self):
+        if self.peek()[1] == '[':
+            headers = self.bracket_items()
+            if self.peek()[1] == ';':
+                self.i += 1
+                rows = []
+                while self.peek()[1] != ']':
+                    vals = self.bracket_items()
+                    rows.append({str(h): vals[n] if n < len(vals) else None for n, h in enumerate(headers)})
+                self.expect(']')
+                return rows
+            self.expect(']')
+            return [headers]
+        vals = []
+        while self.peek()[1] != ']':
+            vals.append(self.expr())
+        self.expect(']')
+        return vals
+
+    def bracket_items(self):
+        self.expect('[')
+        vals = []
+        while self.peek()[1] != ']':
+            vals.append(self.expr())
+        self.expect(']')
+        return vals
+
+    def record(self):
+        d = {}
+        while self.peek()[1] != '}':
+            typ, key = self.peek(); self.i += 1
+            if typ not in ('word', 'str'):
+                raise NuError('record key')
+            self.expect(':')
+            d[str(key)] = self.expr()
+        self.expect('}')
+        return d
+
+    def cell_path(self, val):
+        while self.peek()[0] == 'word' and self.peek()[1].startswith('.'):
+            path = self.peek()[1][1:]; self.i += 1
+            for p in path.split('.'):
+                if p == '': continue
+                opt = p.endswith('?'); p = p[:-1] if opt else p
+                val = get_cell(val, p, opt)
+        return val
+
+    def peek(self):
+        return self.tokens[self.i]
+
+    def expect(self, v):
+        if self.peek()[1] != v:
+            raise NuError('expected ' + v)
+        self.i += 1
+
+
+def split_words(tokens):
+    return [v for t, v in tokens if t != 'eof']
+
+
+def parse_arg_tokens(tokens, env):
+    if not tokens:
+        return None
+    return Parser.from_tokens(tokens, env).expr()
+
+
+def run_command(inp, tokens, env):
+    words = split_words(tokens)
+    if not words:
+        return inp
+    cmd = words[0]
+    if cmd in ('echo', 'print'):
+        return parse_arg_tokens(tokens[1:], env)
+    if cmd == 'from' and len(words) > 1:
+        return from_format(inp, words[1])
+    if cmd == 'to' and len(words) > 1:
+        raw = '-r' in words or '--raw' in words
+        return to_format(inp, words[1], raw)
+    if cmd == 'get':
+        if len(words) < 2: raise NuError('missing get path')
+        val = inp
+        for p in words[1].split('.'):
+            val = get_cell(val, p, p.endswith('?'))
+        return val
+    if cmd == 'select':
+        cols = words[1:]
+        if isinstance(inp, list): return [{c: r.get(c) for c in cols if isinstance(r, dict) and c in r} for r in inp]
+        if isinstance(inp, dict): return {c: inp.get(c) for c in cols if c in inp}
+    if cmd == 'reject':
+        cols = set(words[1:])
+        if isinstance(inp, list): return [{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k not in cols} for r in inp]
+        if isinstance(inp, dict): return {k:v for k,v in inp.items() if k not in cols}
+    if cmd == 'where':
+        if not isinstance(inp, list): raise NuError("command doesn't support input")
+        expr_toks = tokens[1:]
+        out = []
+        for row in inp:
+            e = dict(env); e.update({'it': row, 'in': row})
+            if isinstance(row, dict): e.update(row)
+            if truthy(Parser.from_tokens(expr_toks, e).expr()): out.append(row)
+        return out
+    if cmd == 'sort' or cmd == 'sort-by':
+        ci = '-i' in words
+        keys = [w for w in words[1:] if not w.startswith('-')]
+        def k(x):
+            y = get_cell(x, keys[0], True) if keys else x
+            return str(y).lower() if ci else y
+        return sorted(inp, key=k)
+    if cmd == 'length': return len(inp)
+    if cmd == 'first': return inp[0] if isinstance(inp, list) and inp else inp
+    if cmd == 'last': return inp[-1] if isinstance(inp, list) and inp else inp
+    if cmd == 'columns': return list(inp[0].keys()) if isinstance(inp, list) and inp and isinstance(inp[0], dict) else list(inp.keys())
+    if cmd == 'compact': return [x for x in inp if x is not None]
+    if cmd == 'math': return math_cmd(inp, words[1:])
+    if cmd == 'str': return str_cmd(inp, words[1:], tokens[2:], env)
+    if cmd == 'split' and len(words) > 2:
+        sep = parse_arg_tokens(tokens[2:], env)
+        if words[1] == 'row': return str(inp).split(str(sep))
+        if words[1] == 'column':
+            parts = str(inp).split(str(sep)); return {f'column{i+1}': v for i, v in enumerate(parts)}
+    if cmd == 'lines': return str(inp).splitlines()
+    if cmd == 'open':
+        path = words[1].strip('"\'')
+        with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f: data = f.read()
+        ext = os.path.splitext(path)[1].lower()
+        return from_format(data, 'json' if ext == '.json' else 'csv' if ext == '.csv' else 'text')
+    if cmd == 'save':
+        path = words[-1].strip('"\'')
+        with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f: f.write(render_text(inp))
+        return None
+    if cmd == 'ls':
+        path = words[1] if len(words) > 1 else '.'
+        return [{'name': p, 'type': 'dir' if os.path.isdir(p) else 'file', 'size': os.path.getsize(p)} for p in os.listdir(path)]
+    raise NuError('Command `' + cmd + '` not found')
+
+
+def get_cell(val, p, opt=False):
+    if p.endswith('?'):
+        opt = True; p = p[:-1]
+    try:
+        if isinstance(val, list):
+            if p.lstrip('-').isdigit(): return val[int(p)]
+            return [get_cell(x, p, opt) for x in val]
+        if isinstance(val, dict): return val[p]
+    except Exception:
+        if opt: return None
+        raise NuError('cannot find column')
+    if opt: return None
+    raise NuError('cannot access cell')
+
+
+def truthy(x): return not (x is False or x is None)
+
+
+def apply_op(op, a, b):
+    if op == '+': return a + b
+    if op == '-': return a - b
+    if op == '*': return a * b
+    if op == '/': return a / b
+    if op == '//': return a // b
+    if op == '**': return a ** b
+    if op == 'mod': return a % b
+    if op == 'bit-or': return int(a) | int(b)
+    if op == 'bit-and': return int(a) & int(b)
+    if op == 'bit-xor': return int(a) ^ int(b)
+    if op == 'bit-shl': return int(a) << int(b)
+    if op == 'bit-shr': return int(a) >> int(b)
+    if op == 'and': return truthy(a) and truthy(b)
+    if op == 'or': return truthy(a) or truthy(b)
+    if op == 'xor': return truthy(a) ^ truthy(b)
+    if op == '==': return a == b
+    if op == '!=': return a != b
+    if op == '<': return None if a is None or b is None else a < b
+    if op == '<=': return None if a is None or b is None else a <= b
+    if op == '>': return None if a is None or b is None else a > b
+    if op == '>=': return None if a is None or b is None else a >= b
+    if op == '=~': return str(b) in str(a)
+    if op == '!~': return str(b) not in str(a)
+    if op in ('in', 'has'): return a in b
+    if op in ('not-in', 'not-has'): return a not in b
+    if op in ('..', '..<'):
+        end = int(b) - (1 if op == '..<' and b >= a else -1 if op == '..<' else 0)
+        step = 1 if int(a) <= end else -1
+        return list(range(int(a), end + step, step))
+    raise NuError('bad operator')
+
+
+def from_format(inp, fmt):
+    text = render_text(inp)
+    if fmt == 'json': return json.loads(text)
+    if fmt == 'csv':
+        return [dict(r) for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text))]
+    return text
+
+
+def to_format(inp, fmt, raw=False):
+    if fmt == 'json':
+        return TextOut(json.dumps(inp, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')) if raw else json.dumps(inp, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), True)
+    if fmt == 'csv':
+        rows = inp if isinstance(inp, list) else [inp]
+        if not rows: return TextOut('', True)
+        buf = io.StringIO(); w = csv.DictWriter(buf, fieldnames=list(rows[0].keys()), lineterminator='\n')
+        w.writeheader(); w.writerows(rows); return TextOut(buf.getvalue(), False)
+    if fmt == 'nuon': return TextOut(to_nuon(inp), True)
+    return TextOut(render_text(inp), True)
+
+
+def math_cmd(inp, args):
+    op = args[0] if args else 'sum'
+    vals = inp if isinstance(inp, list) else [inp]
+    if op == 'sum': return sum(vals)
+    if op == 'product':
+        r = 1
+        for v in vals: r *= v
+        return r
+    if op == 'avg': return sum(vals) / len(vals)
+    if op == 'min': return min(vals)
+    if op == 'max': return max(vals)
+    if op == 'median': return statistics.median(vals)
+    if op == 'abs': return [abs(v) for v in vals] if isinstance(inp, list) else abs(inp)
+    if op == 'ceil': return [math.ceil(v) for v in vals] if isinstance(inp, list) else math.ceil(inp)
+    if op == 'floor': return [math.floor(v) for v in vals] if isinstance(inp, list) else math.floor(inp)
+    if op == 'round': return [round(v) for v in vals] if isinstance(inp, list) else round(inp)
+    if op == 'sqrt': return [math.sqrt(v) for v in vals] if isinstance(inp, list) else math.sqrt(inp)
+    raise NuError('unknown math command')
+
+
+def str_cmd(inp, args, toks, env):
+    sub = args[0] if args else ''
+    if sub == 'join':
+        sep = parse_arg_tokens(toks[1:], env) if len(toks) > 1 else ''
+        return TextOut(str(sep).join(map(render_text, inp)), False)
+    if sub == 'length': return len(str(inp))
+    if sub == 'upcase': return str(inp).upper()
+    if sub == 'downcase': return str(inp).lower()
+    if sub == 'trim': return str(inp).strip()
+    if sub == 'contains': return str(parse_arg_tokens(toks[1:], env)) in str(inp)
+    if sub == 'starts-with': return str(inp).startswith(str(parse_arg_tokens(toks[1:], env)))
+    if sub == 'ends-with': return str(inp).endswith(str(parse_arg_tokens(toks[1:], env)))
+    return str(inp)
+
+
+def render_text(v):
+    if isinstance(v, TextOut): return v.text
+    if v is None: return ''
+    if v is True: return 'true'
+    if v is False: return 'false'
+    if isinstance(v, float) and v.is_integer(): return str(int(v)) + '.0' if False else str(int(v))
+    return str(v)
